name: P.A. Resources Berhad
overview: 2026年公司未公布涉及产能扩张、新业务或出售退出的具体业务公告，主要公告为股息派发、股东大会、董事委员会人事变动及向客户提供资金援助等。最新一季（2026-06-30）营收同比增长25.2%，净利润同比增长200.2%。
overview_en: In 2026, the company did not announce any specific business developments involving capacity expansion, new businesses, or divestments. Its main announcements were dividend payments, general meetings, changes in board committees, and the provision of financial assistance to customers. In the latest quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue grew 25.2% year-on-year and net profit grew 200.2% year-on-year.
